service.name: MSQ Completion Boost
service.longDescription: The main scenario is the heart of Eorzea’s story — but not everyone has the time to live through every chapter. Our MSQ Completion boost carries your character through the Main Scenario up to your chosen expansion, unlocking duties, trials and endgame content along the way.

rewards.title: MSQ Completed
rewards.text: Main Scenario completed up to your chosen expansion.

rewards.title: Main Story Rewards
rewards.text: Acquire MSQ specific Mounts, Minions and Glamour.

rewards.title: Time Saver
rewards.text: Skip hundreds of hours of story content and cutscenes.

rewards.title: Ready for Endgame
rewards.text: Jump straight into endgame content on your job of choice.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Have a main Job at the level required for the furthest expansion selected
